work: Added a machine-readable observability contract that maps all nine Visual Fidelity categories and all twelve critical defects to required full-frame views and native 100% crop references.

Changed the numeric Visual Fidelity evaluator so every invocation performs render-evidence provenance validation internally; direct CLI/reflection calls can no longer rely only on file existence and skip the SHA-256/pixel-exact checks.
Added per-category observedViews and observedCropRefs requirements. Generic prose is no longer sufficient to award points.
Added per-critical-defect observedViews and observedCropRefs requirements plus mandatory non-empty evidence notes even when the reviewer marks present=false.
Added deduction-rationale enforcement whenever a category is scored below its maximum weight.
Validated the observability contract against the canonical hero/oblique/grazing views and known 100% crop IDs so unknown or duplicate evidence references fail.

verification.githubCompare: startHead -> substantiveHead is ahead 2, behind 0; exactly two changed files and both are under UnityProject.
verification.verificationMode: GitHub source/static verification only; Unity runtime unavailable.

expectedImpact: Prevents false Geometry/Material/Lighting/Texture/Weathering/Vegetation/Period/Cinematic/Temporal category points that are not tied to an observable benchmark view or 100% crop.
Prevents a critical defect from being dismissed with an empty evidence field.
Prevents the public numeric evaluator from accidentally bypassing render provenance checks.
Does not improve the rendered pixels by itself and therefore awards no Visual Fidelity points.

criticalFinding: The current benchmark still set can show spatial aliasing at sampled viewpoints, but a single still cannot prove temporal shimmer or visible LOD transition stability. The temporal_lod_aliasing category and the severe_aliasing_or_shimmer / visible_lod_pop critical checks therefore still need dedicated runtime motion evidence before a fully defensible 92/100 PASS can be claimed.
nextBlocker: Implement and seal a deterministic native-4K temporal probe sequence for fine-detail subpixel motion and LOD-distance crossings, then bind that sequence to temporal_lod_aliasing and the shimmer/LOD critical checks. If a Unity runner appears first, stop speculative expansion, compile current HEAD and capture real hero/oblique/grazing evidence before any additional visual work.
note: Implementation readiness is separate from Visual Fidelity. No category was visually scored because there is still no actual Unity render evidence.
